b) | DRS Activation 2: Panels 10, 11
[page 5]
15) | Track Limits
15.1 | In accordance with the provisions of Article 33.3, the white lines define the track edges. During
Qualifying and the Race, each time a driver fails to negotiate with the track limits, this will result in
that lap time being invalidated by the Stewards.
15.2 | The dotted white line across the support category pit exit is the track edge line.
16) | Fire extinguishers around the circuit
Fire extinguishers are located at each marshal post.
